description: Synthetic evaluation corpus for the Multimodal Submission Integrity Engine. All content is original synthetic text written for this project or machine-synthesized speech; no proprietary, copyrighted, or private student data is used.

submission_001_greencharge.pdf.role: original analysis (GreenCharge market entry); shares the common case prompt header; section 2 is read aloud verbatim in submission_011_pitch.mp4

submission_002_farmfresh.pdf.role: original analysis (station operations); shares the common case prompt header only

submission_003_drones.pdf.role: original analysis (drone logistics); copied word-for-word by submission_007_drones_copy.docx

submission_004_vertical_ev.pdf.role: framing is original, but two passages are copied verbatim from reference_kb/vertical_integration.txt

submission_006_greencharge_reworded.docx.role: genuine paraphrase of submission_001_greencharge.pdf (same arguments, reworded); semantic match expected despite low string overlap

submission_007_drones_copy.docx.role: word-for-word copy of submission_003_drones.pdf across formats

submission_008_quickcommerce.docx.role: essay generated by an LLM (disclosed); should score high on the AI-content indicator

submission_009_hospital.docx.role: original analysis (hospital queues); shares the common case prompt header only

submission_010_edtech.docx.role: original analysis (edtech gamification); shares the common case prompt header only

submission_011_pitch.mp4.role: spoken pitch reading section 2 of submission_001_greencharge.pdf verbatim (synthetic speech)

submission_012_silent.mp4.role: degraded input: valid video with no audio stream

submission_013_original_pitch.mp4.role: original spoken pitch (synthetic speech), no matching text anywhere in the corpus

benign_shared_template.note: These files share only the identical ~115-word case prompt header; the pipeline must isolate this as common template text and NOT flag these documents as plagiarized against each other.
